limits.name: maxArgs
limits.recipe: headers -j plus N distinct short file operands: count=2+N; admit input-file override <=256. Hard-scale runtime witness may be unreachable under cardinality; do not invent repeated flags.

limits.name: maxArgumentBytes
limits.unit: sum UTF-8 bytes of argv; reject unpaired surrogates
limits.recipe: select plus one long valid header-name selector: six command bytes plus N selector bytes; matching header exists. Raise selector-byte cap only within its hard ceiling; hard-scale witness may be constrained.

limits.name: maxInputFiles
limits.recipe: headers -j over N distinct one-header files; use defaults for N=15,16,17; all bytes/effects independently enumerated.

limits.name: maxInputBytes
limits.recipe: stream ASCII rows of 1024 bytes (1023 a then LF), then one remainder; count permits ragged final width. Partition <=65536; independent sum is exact; no stored giant payload.

limits.name: maxChunks
limits.recipe: N-1 empty deliveries followed by one a+LF delivery; delivered count=N and count output 0+LF if admitted.

limits.name: maxChunkBytes
limits.unit: full borrowed delivery length, independent of owned occupancy
limits.recipe: one delivery of repeated 16 ASCII digits plus LF, then remainder; count avoids width constraint. Ensure records/input/work caps do not bind first.

limits.name: maxRecordBytes
limits.unit: raw record syntax excluding final LF/CRLF, not embedded terminators
limits.recipe: one count record of target bytes split by commas into cells below cell cap; add terminal LF outside target; stream <=65536-byte chunks.

limits.name: maxCellBytes
limits.unit: raw cell syntax including quotes/embedded line endings, excluding separators
limits.recipe: count one ASCII cell of target bytes plus LF; second quoted variant reserves two quote bytes and counts doubled quotes explicitly; keep record/chunk caps separate.

limits.name: maxColumns
limits.unit: all fields including trailing empty fields
limits.recipe: count record with N-1 commas and N short cells; trailing-empty variant same field count; other caps slack.

limits.name: maxRecords
limits.unit: all parsed nonblank logical records including header/template/skipped rows
limits.recipe: h+LF then N-1 copies x+LF; count header mode output N-1 plus LF; no blank-line substitution.

limits.name: maxSelectorBytes
limits.recipe: select one valid name of N ASCII bytes matched by header; argv budget raised within cap; output/retained bytes separately admitted.

limits.name: maxSelectorNodes
limits.recipe: bounded valid numeric-list/occurrence recipes, with independent node ledger after B01 resolution; do not assume one token equals one node or derive expected count from production parser.

limits.name: maxSelectorDepth
limits.unit: list depth 1, clause depth 2; no recursive grammar
limits.recipe: depth-2 legal selector against configured depth 1/2; configuration 3 fails above hard ceiling. No legal depth-3 input is invented; unreachable runtime L+1 is NOT A PASS.

limits.name: maxSelectedColumns
limits.recipe: select a bounded repeated numeric column list; independently sum emitted positions; selector bytes/nodes may bind earlier and require permitted overrides.

limits.name: maxLastRows
limits.unit: both requested positive tail size and occupied ring
limits.recipe: slice -L N with N tiny data records and a header; request L+1 rejects before reads, within bound emits after EOF; -L0 is separately Z01/Z02, not a positive override.

limits.name: maxWork
limits.unit: each inspected/compared byte, emitted index and copied/decoded/encoded/output byte; repeats charge again
limits.recipe: independent trace ledger of scanner/selector/copy/output events, split-phase cumulative stress; requires implementation observability binding, no new public hook. Input length is not a work proxy.

limits.name: maxOutputBytes
limits.unit: aggregate reserved stdout/stderr/file bytes including quoting/LF/diagnostics
limits.recipe: admitted repeated-column serialization with exact independent output-size arithmetic; bounded count/digest sink, not retained whole-output collection; parent/selector/retained constraints must be disclosed.

limits.name: maxRetainedBytes
limits.unit: simultaneous owned buffer capacity +2/UTF16 unit +8/index slot +32/node/span/ring slot
limits.recipe: independent capacity ledger for header/ring/scratch/fallback segments and assembly old+new+final buffer; borrowed incoming storage/provider allocation excluded from owned tally, not called unbounded-safe.
